batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c DE Bollinger b SB Jakati

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c KMDN Kulasekara b R Ashwin

batting.name: OA Shah
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b KMDN Kulasekara

batting.name: AL Menaria
batting.dismissal: c SB Jakati b DE Bollinger

batting.name: S Badrinath
batting.dismissal: st SP Goswami b GB Hogg

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c SP Goswami b KK Cooper

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b KK Cooper

balls.text: gone, is it gone, yes he has been dismissed off the last ball of the innings, yorker length, outside the off-stump, edged and taken by the wicket-keeper MS Dhoni.
driven to the covers and they are off for a single.
hits over extra-cover and they are able to take two on the midfield.
and again, I can copy my previous comment! Goes for a slog shot and misses yet again, only this was fuller this time!
goes for a slog shot and misses yet again.
wanted to smack it over the long-off fielder, mistimed and Bravo dived forward for the catch, misses it.
beaten! outside the off-stump and the Australian gets better of his countryman, beats the outside edge and Dhoni collects it well this time.
goes for a slog shot and this time he is caught! There was one fielder in the circle on the leg-side and the heave goes straight to the right of Jakati.
outside the off-stump, full-toss and Shah goes for a slash over the covers, misses hitting the middle of the bat and it lands in the covers between three fielders
outside the off-stump and dug out well to the long-on fielder for a single
fifty for Shah! Swivels towards the leg-side, pushes to the deep square-leg for a single
full-toss and that has been slogged away over the mid-wicket area for a six! Some respite for the batsmen who would be sweating after that previous over!
pre-meditates the paddle sweep but gets him only a nick to the pads and a single
outside the off-stump, missed by Shah.
down the leg-side and he tries to heave it away, misses it, hits the pads and they go for a run, bowler picks it up on his follow-through and tries to throw the stumps down, misses.
smacked straight to long-on and that is well fielded yet again on the bounce. They look too tired to come back for the second...
slower one and Shah wanted to go over the straight boundary, missed it because of the slower one.
full-toss and that is spanked back straight, very well fielded by Bravo at long-on, who moved to his right
slower outside the off-stump and that is driven away to the deep point region for a single. 13 from that over, following 22 and 9 in the last two overs.
pitched up, coming into the bat, he tries to go over the covers, gets it in the gap and they come back for a second.
outside the off-stump, wider this time and he tries to repeat that stroke that he played off the first ball, misses it this time.
slower one, over-pitched, driven but unfortunately for the batsman, straight to the fielder.
shot, shot, shot! That was coming into Menaria who looked cramped for room but he swings it over long-on for a six!
outside the off-stump, pitched up and that has been squeezed that one through the gap between the two points. Both dived, one to his left and the other to left and they missed it!
yorker, well bowled, Shah was on his route to moving towards the off-stump but the delivery stopped his movements dead and he taps it back to the bowler.
outside the off-stump and that is dug out by Shah and played to the point region for a single
shortish yet again and that is pulled away by Shah for a four! This is superb acceleration from Shah after struggling initially in this game.
short ball and top-edged! Goes over the wicket-keeper for a four! Shah wants a change of gloves after that stroke, wonder what he did during the Time-Out that got done three deliveries ago.
outside the off-stump and that is slashed away to the deep cover for a single
outside the off-stump, Menaria tries to late cut it to third-man but he fails to connect, beaten outside the off.
yorker length ball outside the off-stump, beats the batsman and with that we will have a Time-Out
and this time it is down the leg-side! Deliberately missed by the batsman and the wicket-keeper was blinded, misses it yet again...that is his third miss today.
goes to his leg-stump again and puts Jadeja off, who sends down a lip-smacking full-toss, and Shah has smashed it through the covers for a four!
pitched right up to the bat and Menaria wisely drives it to long-on for a single
no room given this time, and Shah plays it to the leg-side for a single
finally some sharp movement in the scorecard, goes to the leg-side and almost chips it over long-off for a six!
driven straight back, Jadeja dives to his right and fields well
wide outside the off-stump, this time Shah tried to move but did not, it was way too wide and Dhoni missed it again!
outside the off-stump, on length and Menaria fails to connect, beaten outside the off-stump, goes through to the keeper.
full-toss, drilled to long-on for a single
Tries for the slog yet again and surprise, surprise, he misses again! Just not got his timing right today except that six.
goes for a slog over mid-wicket but the change in pace beats him.
outside the off-stump, would have been a wide had he left it but cuts it to the sweeper region for a couple
from around the wicket, pitched on middle, hint of deviation away, gets an outside edge and a single to third-man
again pitched full, Menaria wanted to go over the top but cannot get under it and that is driven straight to the long-off region for a single
full-toss yet again and driven back to the bowler. Misfielded but no chance for a single
pitched up to the bat, flicks it to the deep square-leg for a single
tries to slog it away, gets an inside edge and away to the fine-leg region for a run
outside the off-stump and Shah again gave himself room, couldn't reach the ball, leaves it and Dhoni misses it.
full-toss and that is hit away towards long-on but misses finding the gap. Gets only a single
pitched fullish, and he goes for a big hit, goes on a bounce to the fielder at long-on.
shorter this time, pulled away for a single
well bowled, Shah gave himself room by moving to the leg-side and he sends it to outside the off-stump, had no option but to leave it
shorter outside the off-stump and that is cut away to the covers for a single
on the middle-stump this time, length ball, this time he slog-sweeps it, almost flicks it and they get a single.
outside the off-stump, not turning in and tries to cut it, beaten.
on the pads and Menaria pulls him away to fine-leg for a single
dabbed to the leg-side and rushes off for a single.
dropped! Driven, straight back at the bowler, catchable, and Ashwin has put it down!
floated up in the air and that is driven to the deep mid-wicket region and they call 'two' as soon as he had hit it.
goes outside the leg-stump, gives himself room and has cut it away for four.
pitching on middle, coming in and driven to the long-off region, it looked like it was pad first, there was an appeal but the umpire ruled it not out.
this time he plays it to the deep square-leg region but the player takes time to rush into the circle and they are able to get back for their second run easily.
round the wicket, down the leg-side and dabbed away to the short fine-leg, wanted a single but non-striker sends him back
leg-side yet again and that is turned away for a single to deep square-leg
on the middle-stump and that is on-driven to the deep square-leg for a couple.
outside the off-stump, quicker and tries to cut, beaten.
punched it down the ground for a single to long-on
pitched up and driven back to the bowler
dropped is it? Slowed the ball, turn, bounce and takes the edge and goes to the wide second slip region. Raina's on the first slip and there is no way he could have taken that
a tad quicker, and Menaria tries to push it through the covers yet again and the outside edge goes through to the third-man region for a four
shorter this time and pushed to the covers
driven on the front-foot yet again but to the fielder
around the wicket, on the middle and the new batsman defends on the front foot.

and this time he is out, caught! Dravid was getting frustrated with his inability to score runs in the last couple of overs, he tries to go down the pitch and play it over the long-off fielder, it beaten in the flight and caught at long-off.
shorter one from Jakati and he tries to cut it, mistimes the stroke
down the leg-side, but very full, tried to sweep it away but did not get any bat to it.
and now he walks to the off-side yet again, plays away to the leg-side for a single
Aww, that is a stunning stroke from Owais Shah! He had been struggling to get some runs this innings, but for this one, he shimmies down and sends him over long-on.
down the pitch and he defends it back to the bowler
outside the off-stump and Shah has driven the bowler down the ground for his first run this innings.
on the pads and Shah plays it to the off-side!
flights it up and Shah defends on the front foot again
pitched right up and Shah plays it back to the bowler
on the pads and Dravid's flicked it away for a single
floated up in the air and Dravid defends on the front foot.
outside the off-stump, defended back to the bowler.

Missed! Run-out missed from the short fine-leg region. Bravo was the fielder and he tried to throw down the non-striker's end stumps but misses, Dravid, attempting a single after pushing it to the fielder, was a yard away.
short ball yet again and Dravid went rather hard at it, does not get it in the middle of the bat and misses out on a boundary.
punched to the cover region but for no run.
pitched right up to the bat, he digs it out and it bounces over the stump, Dravid wanted a single but he is sent back.
short ball and that has got the bottom-edge and it goes to the fine-leg region for a four.
on the middle-stump, moving away to the off-stump, defended on the leg-side.
pitched up and driven back to the bowler.
tame, tame dismissal there, Rahane in some good form, tries to go over mid-off but that was rather meekly hit, not powered, and it goes straight to the mid-off fielder.
punched back down the ground for a single
pitched right up to the bat and driven to the leg-side for a run.
on the length, pushed back to the bowler.
slower and that has been picked from outside the off-stump and deposited into the boundary region behind the bowler! What a shot!
outside the off-stump and Dravid was coming down the pitch, punches it to the cover region but goes straight to the fielder.
pitched up, slower and driven to the mid-on region.
slower, outside the off-stump and dabbed it away to the third-man region for a single
short ball after that initial full ball and with no-one at fine-leg, Rahane just helps it along to that region for the second four of the over!
What a welcome! Bravo comes on to bowl and that has been hit on the up, through the extra-cover region for a four.
wanted to play it through the leg-side, but it hits the inside edge of the bat, hits the pads and then goes nowhere. Decent over after that boundary.
pitched up and driven back hard, hits Kulasekara on his foot and stops it from going for any runs
length ball, bit of bounce and that is played away to the covers.
and he walks down to the bowler this time and has flicked it away to the leg-side for a couple of runs
slower one, but pitched right up to the bat and Dravid spots it early, driven through the covers for four.
length ball on the middle stump and played back to the bowler.
short of length, outside the off-stump and dabbed away to point.
flicks it to the fielder at deep square-leg for a single
short and Dravid has slogged it away through the square-leg region for a four. He usually loves pulling them in front of square, this was behind it.
short of good length, Rahane goes on to the back-foot, punches it back to the mid-off fielder, who had to move to his right to field.
outside the off-stump and punched well again, goes to the covers.
outside the off-stump, angling across, tapped on the off-side and they are away. Rahane, in his form, is eager to get to the striker's end.
wide outside the off-stump, Dravid struggled to try and get there and was still not able to and the wide was promptly called
punched and the Orange Cap holder shows the reason why he wears that cap! Straight bat and that had a touch of class to it, goes through the covers for four.
the fine-leg was brought in, deep square-leg outside the circle and Dravid plays it away to that fielder sent back. Single takes Dravid to 1.
pitched up, Dravid goes down the pitch and was still able to drive to mid-on with grace. Hit well but straight to the fielder.
good length ball and driven back to the bowler.
Ooooh! That was jagging back into the batsman and an inside edge saves him. There was an lbw appeal
outside the off-stump, not too much swing, stayed low. Dravid tries to slash at it, misses the under-edge and it goes through on the bounce to the keeper.

bad ball under the circumstances, full toss drifting down, flicked away to the leg-side, and while it is fielded well at deep square-leg by Cooper, they are able to get back for the second run. The throw was a tad awry, but he should have made it anyway!
yorker yet again and that has been played away to long-off for...only a single! What have Chennai done, why have they taken it to the last ball?
slower yet again, driven to mid-off and Dravid slides and they get a single.
yorker and played away well though by Dhoni, through to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
up and over, through the extra-cover region for only a single!
Slower one and played away to the off side for a single
dabs it away to the short third-man fielder for a single
swing and miss! Tried to send it into the next state but misses it as it was much slower.
pulled away by Dhoni and they are able to come back for the second run again.
played away to leg-side, easy run taken
that is an excellent bal, yorker and dug out well, goes to mid-on and they come back for the second as the long-on fielder needed to run into the circle
fullish ball, played away to the leg-side and the pair run quickly enough to get their second run! Hogg could do nothing to prevent it.
that has been flicked away by Dhoni through the short fine-leg region for a four, that has made Chennai favourites yet again!
played away to the deep square-leg region for a single
inside out and that has been sent over the covers for four! That is well hit by Bravo and that reduces the pressure for the side.
Bravo tries to go inside-out and that is misfielded by Binny this time, and it goes through to the sweeper for a couple.
played away to the covers and they are off for a single, this time the ball is collected well and the stumps are hit direct, but Dhoni's in.
Oooh! Run-out chance missed and they get an overthrow! Driven to the covers and well fielded by Binny, who tries to throw the stumps down at the striker's end, Bravo was way out, misses.
shorter this time and hit into the covers, but not for runs! Only 2 runs off the over and they lost two wickets there.
slower one and Dhoni almost chips it back to the bowler!
outside the off-stump, driven through the covers for a single.

gone, caught by Rahane at long-off...that was slapped high up in the air and for most part, it looked like that the ball was going to sail over but Rahane takes an excellent catch at the edge of the fence!
full-toss and driven to the long-off region for a single

gone, finally, edged and taken! He went down the pitch, tried to slam it away, gets an edge through to the wicket-keeper and there was a period of waiting as he looked at the umpires over whether the ball had carried, out says the ump.
down the track and driven to long-on for a single. Signs of exhaustion from du Plessis after what has been a superb innings.
down the leg-side, after du Plessis came down the track and missed it, wide called.
cut away and that will go over the covers for a couple, gets to his highest score in the IPL.
driven to the covers for a couple, mis-fielded by the fielder at extra-cover.
slower than a slower ball, 105.5 km/hr, and Raina was down the track an hour early for his train. Still manages to play it to the leg-side for a single
Raina has slogged it away to the leg-side for a four! That is one of his favourite shots and he has finally connected. 50-run stand posted.
pulled away to the leg-side for a single
played away to the leg-side for a single
goes down the track and that has actually gone away for a six! Why I say that is because it barely looked like it had the power, but it did have the timing!
pitched up to the bat, driven by Raina to the long-on fielder for a single
slower from Trivedi, played out to the off-side and they get only a single.
on the pads and that should have been put away, instead, beats him as it hits his pads.
short and pulled away and that was going to the fence...till Menaria dived full length to his right and saved a couple!
tried to defend it, gets a bit of a leading edge and that allows him a single.
outside the off stump, played away to the off side for no run.
short ball from Hogg and Raina nudges it away for a single. They are playing him out.
pitched right up and driven to mid-wicket for a single
played away to the leg-side for another single.
wrong 'un, read it well on the back-foot and played to mid-wicket for a single
on the off-stump, keeps a little low, flicked away to the leg-side.
goes for a heave, but does not get off the middle of the bat and gets only a single
played away to the leg-side for a single
slower ball and pitched right up to the bat and he punches it to the long-off fielder for a run.
driven to the extra-cover fielder.
driven straight to the long-on for a single. du Plessis has played just one false stroke today. Otherwise, it has been an excellent innings.
nudged away to the leg-side for a single
that is edged away by Raina and it falls short of the third-man fielder, Trivedi. He went for an expansive inside-out stroke.
tried to pull it and he misses the shot.
outside the off-stump, shorter and he tries to slap it away to the fence but misses the middle of the bat.
down the leg-side and that is flicked away to the fine-leg for a four, there was a fielder in place but he was a touch squarer.
on his pads and that is flicked away to the square-leg fielder for a single. Third fifty of the tournament this season, the most so far!
slower ball and that is the sixth single of the over, played away to the long-on fielder.
on the off-stump, keeps a tad low and that is played away to the leg-side for a run. The bowler had a shy at the stumps but missed by a mile
tapped away to the off-side and he is away for another single
opens the face of the bat, played away to the off side for a single. Doing it easily here.
flicked away to the leg-side for a single.
on the middle, slower one, punched back to long-on for a single.
tossed up and driven to long-on for a single
comes down the track and defends it back to the bowler.
tries to play it to the leg-side, closes the face of the bat, gets a leading edge.
pitched up to the bat and defended on the off side.
driven down the ground for a single
pitched fuller and played away to the leg-side for a single
on a length, pitched outside the off-stump and punched to long-on, Strategic Time-Out time.
shorter, this time slower and Raina swivels and gets a single to the deep square-leg region for a single
short and wide and that is cut away by Raina for a four!
slower from Trivedi and he tries to smack it down the ground, was in the air but just away from the right hand of the bowler.
an appeal for an lbw, but pitching outside the leg-stump and the batsmen cross over for a leg-bye.
driven to the long-on fielder and takes off for an easy run.
on his pads and that is flicked away to the fine-leg. Only four from the over and a wicket.
goes forward, flicks it  to the leg-side and Raina gets off the mark.
comes into the batsman, defends on the back-foot and loud call of 'No'
gone, stumped! Hogg has had Badri stumped, wrong 'un, bit of flight, tried to go over the extra-cover, but missed, the batsman was out of the crease and Goswami quickly whips off the bails.
wrong 'un and dabbed away for a single. There is a slip in place too.
pitched up to the bat, tries to go over extra-cover but can get it through covers for a run.
punched to the covers for no run. That is their second successive 50-run stand by the way.
saw him coming down the pitch, and delivered it slower, beat them in the air but gets a single.
driven down the ground for a single to long-on
goes down the pitch and lofts it over the extra-cover region for a six! The form continues!
again outside the off-stump, goes straight on, driven to the covers for no run.
around the wicket, slow, pitched up, went for a cut but to the point.
another chinaman and played away to the off-side. No run, five runs off the over after conceding a boundary off the first.
this is a chinaman, turns a little, bounce and that is played away to the leg-side.
Oooh! Gets the wrong 'un right, moves away, beats Badri outside the off-stump.
pitched up and flicked away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
another short one, wrong 'un and gets away with it, the pull goes to the fielder
pitching short and coming in to the bat, punched through the covers and that has gone through for a four!
quicker one, goes for an under cut but misses.
goes down the track and punches it to mid-off for a single
pulled away and it is four once again! That was short and he was hit between the deep square-leg and long-on for a four.
tucks away and that runs through to the fine-leg for a four! The short fine-leg fielder gave a decent chase but did not dive in the end...
goes down the track, gets an outside edge, goes through to the third-man region for a single. Misfielded by Binny but they do not come back.
goes down the track, gets under it and spoons high up in the air, Brad Hogg was there at deep square-leg but it fell way short of the fielder. Survives.
on his pads and that has been played away to the short fine-leg for a couple, Menaria dived and almost pushed it back into the fence.
goes down the track and tries to cut it, it comes out rather slow again and the timing goes awry.
tries to paddle it through the fine-leg region but Sreevats Goswami does well to stop that one.
full-toss, slow yet again, and driven to mid-on for a run
slower yet again and played away gently to the leg-side, they come back for the second by the time the fielder gets to deep square-leg
played away to the short fine-leg and they are off for a quick single, direct throw would have had Faff in trouble
again movement to the off-side from the batsman, and gently taps it away to the leg-side for a single
outside the off-stump, slower one and that is dabbed away to the leg-side for a single
short of length and played away to the third-man region for a single
on the off-stump, the batsman was moving towards the off and played back to mid-on
on the up and that has been punched through the covers for a four! This is a very good start from Chennai...
outside edge and that gets to the fine third-man where the fielder has to run to his left and tidy up.
tries to drive again and this time it beats the outside edge of the bat. Three fours and three dots in the over.
tries to drive on the up and he hits it in the air for a fair distance before it comes down at the covers
classic, too full and he drives it through the extra-cover for a four! Man in form making it count.
outside the off-stump and left alone by the batsman this time. Keeper fumbles.
outside the off-stump and that is punched through the covers for another four! What was I thinking!
no, not yet anyway! Short, and that is pulled away to the deep mid-wicket fence for a four!
pitched up and driven through mid-wicket for a single
goes down the track and tries to send it over the long-on fence, everyone thought it was going over, but goes on the bounce to the fielder and they get only a single
on the stumps, tries to flick it away to mid-on, bowler fields...
slow action and no turn, defended on the front-foot.
floated up yet again and driven to mid-off again
slow, drifts in and driven to the covers
